summary: Official municipal and DGFiP cadastral sources were verified. The municipal parcel ZIP yielded three safe full polygons near the exact WUP point, normalized to native Codeident ids; runtime remains held for independent serial review.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and French discovery queries, exact text, outcomes and first-party URLs are recorded in city-3893-montpellier.json.
requestOutcomes: Municipal dataset HTML and ZIP returned HTTP 200; the ZIP was inspected as a shapefile with 39,518 parcel polygons in EPSG:2154. DGFiP/INSPIRE WMS GetCapabilities returned HTTP 200 and exposed Montpellier vector-plan layers and CRS metadata. A bounded spatial extraction returned three polygons.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point was preserved; no coordinate shift was used.
A bounded sample does not prove every parcel is current or complete citywide.
The official WMS is display-oriented and its documentation says GetFeatureInfo is not implemented; geometry came from the municipal ZIP.
No unsafe owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, registration-detail or personal fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission; serial review remains required.
compositeKeyProvenance: Codeident is the native source-provided composite parcel reference; no synthetic row id was used.
crs: EPSG:2154 source; EPSG:4326/CRS84 retained sample output
geometryQuality: Full unchanged source polygon geometry for three bounded sample features, reprojected from EPSG:2154 to EPSG:4326.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Three local parcel polygons returned by bounded spatial filter; no citywide absence inference.
